items.q: Was 'Bash is all you need' right?
items.a: No: MCP, **code mode, skills and progressive disclosure** now matter too.

items.q: Did React become the last language?
items.a: No: models write **HTML, Swift or Figma JSON equally well**.

items.q: What two shifts is AI causing at once?
items.a: An **industrial revolution** of software factories and a **Renaissance** of quality and taste.
Below the jagged frontier, capability is **broad and even** across tasks.

items.q: Why does the smooth interior matter?
items.a: You can **choose how you want to work** instead of bending to the model.

items.q: What does the land-or-water map show?
items.a: Newer models **know the world almost perfectly**, which matters more than benchmarks.

items.q: What went wrong vibe-coding his game?
items.a: He **didn't know what his characters did** and kept losing flow.
A layer of **linted, English-like code** he reads and tunes, over agent-written engine code.
Readable units make the spec **understandable and editable** by a human.
